comparison: On prior-ablation-full-suite-v1 under protocol seed 0, atlas-particle-normal-v4 achieves 24 PASS, 14 FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE across 38 executed tasks, strictly outperforming atlas-particle-normal-v3 (23 PASS, 12 FAIL, 35 executed; regressed mode_hold), atlas-particle-normal-v2 (22 PASS, 16 FAIL, 38 executed), bispf-optimized-quintic-v1 (20 PASS, 18 FAIL), and atlas-particle-normal-v1 (17 PASS, 18 FAIL), while retaining 6/6 vector, 4/4 image, 2/2 VAE, and 2/2 clockfree passes.
conclusion: Guarding LossSurprise.decide against KA2 pre-anchor critic-only SettledReopenGuard witnesses (guard.ka2_anchor_started is False and witness_roles == {'critic'}) prevented the premature step-35 critic reopen on N=12 mode_hold while preserving post-anchor equilibrium shift detection across CPU and CUDA, recovering mode_hold (8/8 modes, hq=0.9998) and unblocking ring_hold, ring_extension, and target_shift_recovery for 24 PASS, 14 FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE across all 38 executable tasks (6 prerequisite-deferred, 4 shared_pending unrouted adapters) with zero task regressions relative to both atlas-particle-normal-v2 and atlas-particle-normal-v3.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Guarding LossSurprise.decide against KA2 pre-anchor critic-only SettledReopenGuard witnesses (guard.ka2_anchor_started is False and witness_roles == {'critic'}, where the critic ladder has stepped down during Phase A acquisition while the generator ladder remains unsettled at full rate s=1.0) prevents premature step-35 critic re-empowerment on N=12 mode_hold while preserving post-anchor equilibrium shift detection, recovering 8/8 mode_hold and unblocking ring_hold, ring_extension, and target_shift_recovery while retaining birth_death_cells=256 and NormalNoiseManipulator(sigma=0.0065) to preserve all 6/6 vector, 4/4 image, 2/2 VAE, and 2/2 clockfree passes for >= 24 PASS / 0 INCOMPLETE with zero task regressions relative to both atlas-particle-normal-v2 and atlas-particle-normal-v3 under protocol seed 0.
next_action: Investigate adaptive per-population cell budgeting so N=256 rare-mode vector hosts avoid under-resolved k=7 kNN turnover without doubling K=256 FeatureCellBirthDeath cells on N=20000 100-mode tasks (grid100, rotated100, staggered100), and investigate joint-inference stability for BiGAN/DDGAN/five_word_joint hosts.

study.competing_explanation: If blocking KA2 pre-anchor critic-only LossSurprise reopens (guard.ka2_anchor_started is False and witness_roles == {'critic'}) while holding birth_death_cells=256 and NormalNoiseManipulator(sigma=0.0065) fixed fails to recover mode_hold (modes == 8) alongside all 6 vector passes (component_covariance_error <= 0.85) and >= 24 PASS overall, then mode_hold's 7/8 regression in v3 was caused by equilibrium kernel width at sigma=0.0065 rather than premature pre-anchor critic-only LossSurprise reopening.
study.hypothesis: Guarding LossSurprise.decide against KA2 pre-anchor critic-only SettledReopenGuard witnesses (guard.ka2_anchor_started is False and witness_roles == {'critic'}, where the critic ladder has stepped down during Phase A acquisition while the generator ladder remains unsettled at full rate s=1.0) prevents premature step-35 critic re-empowerment on N=12 mode_hold while preserving post-anchor equilibrium shift detection, recovering 8/8 mode_hold and unblocking ring_hold, ring_extension, and target_shift_recovery while retaining birth_death_cells=256 and NormalNoiseManipulator(sigma=0.0065) to preserve all 6/6 vector, 4/4 image, 2/2 VAE, and 2/2 clockfree passes for >= 24 PASS / 0 INCOMPLETE with zero task regressions relative to both atlas-particle-normal-v2 and atlas-particle-normal-v3 under protocol seed 0.
